about: 3rd-year CS Honours student at the University of Manitoba who likes building things that…

posts.text: Logging on to LinkedIn is typically when most of us feel our imposter syndrome peaking, but I'm happy to see that so many of my friends and mutuals have secured internships this summer. I'm glad to share that I am also working as a Technical Support Student at Manitoba Hydro this summer. I'm looking forward to the challenge and applying what I learn to my own projects as the summer goes on. More to come. It's time to get to work!

name: Michelle Okolie
